scope: Actual old-value invalidation / replacement acceptance from supplied sanitized evidence, preserved recorded permissions, known local storage verification, and independent public service availability on unchanged production version. Not a new deployment acceptance or an exhaustive incident-forensics certification.

modelSelection.rationale: Security evidence requires distinguishing account and user verification endpoints, credential rolling from token-record revocation, and availability from remediation; choice supplied by controller contract. No model changes performed.

checks.name: original_identity_bound_to_account_verification
checks.basis: Inspection shows original account token active; verification script independently guards the exact identity before retaining the original value in memory.

checks.name: old_value_invalidated_correct_account_endpoint
checks.basis: Verification source uses /accounts/{accountId}/tokens/verify for both old and new values. The observed old HTTP 401/error 1000 is separate from the earlier user-token endpoint 401. This accepts the reported invalidation of the old credential value, not deletion of the token record.

checks.name: new_value_changed_and_same_token_active
checks.basis: Source emits replacement evidence only after new!=old. New account verify succeeds with the exact original token ID and active status. Same-ID active token is consistent with rolling its secret.

checks.name: new_value_known_read_capabilities
checks.limit: Deployment records, D1 metadata, and R2 listing reads succeed. No deployment upload, database-content access, or business transaction was tested or required.

checks.name: recorded_permissions_preserved_without_expansion
checks.limit: Based on supplied before/after dashboard observations; this reviewer did not access the browser. Existing account-wide permissions were retained, not reduced to least privilege.

checks.name: known_local_storage_synchronized
checks.basis: Replacement verifier reads the changed local source and validates that new value. Local-storage report records Git-ignore and 0600 plus no exact new-value matches in its stated tracked/response scan. No credential source file was opened by this reviewer.
checks.limit: Does not certify all CI, backups, other devices, nested files, or external secret stores.

checks.name: independent_public_health_version_unchanged
checks.basis: Actual reviewer unauthenticated curl observes HTTP 200 and exact existing SHA/platform version, also matching supplied service-after evidence.

checks.name: independent_public_home_available
checks.limit: HTTP reachability only, no logged-in flow or application interaction.

checks.name: bounded_audit_visibility_honestly_reported
checks.limit: Two user-update events and no matching token events in the bounded query do not prove no misuse, complete ingestion, or a token-rotation audit trail. No successful token-rotation event is claimed.

checks.name: response_status_distinguishes_remediation_from_release
checks.basis: No new deployment is asserted. Public health binds current availability to the existing release; old pending scope disposition remains preserved as a historical earlier observation.

checks.name: restricted_review_boundary_and_credential_pattern_check
checks.limit: Pattern checks cover supplied evidence only and do not prove historical tool traces sanitized; original trace is preserved.

residualLimitations: Seven known project-root environment scans do not establish all external CI, backups, devices, nested configurations, historical copies, or process usage. Successful old-value invalidation does not prove all unknown dependencies received the replacement.
Bounded audit results did not expose a matching token event; they neither prove absence of misuse nor complete audit ingestion/coverage.
The original whole-account ten permissions, no selected expiry, and no entered IP filter remain. No least-privilege remediation is claimed.

Cloudflare verification, policy UI, and local-file security evidence were reviewed as controller-supplied sanitized artifacts, not independently repeated with credentials, as prohibited by the review scope.
Public checks establish endpoint behavior at the recorded times, not authenticated business flow coverage or future availability. Original private trace was not erased.

nextAction.action: Record this scoped remediation acceptance in the separate incident ledger, preserving original evidence and residual limitations. Do not claim or close the formal HUMAN-05 unit through this review.
nextAction.dependency: Independent report is available; ledger recording can proceed automatically within controller authorization.
nextAction.followUp: Credential custodian/controller should inventory external dependencies and plan least-privilege reduction before any additional credential policy change; dependency evidence remains incomplete.
